mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the load was most worthwhile because it showed the assembled sensory and motor connections working in a recognizable situation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the cup in the hand was straightforward setup, though it made the later load test possible.

surprise.text: The loaded cup made the sequence clearer: the forearm dips, the flexor stretches, and feedback helps steady it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The named motor slot made that fitting especially clear.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it similarly connects cellular work to an observable body response. The progression here was clear, although most combinations were predictable.
